description: This PHP class defines the data transfer object (DTO) for representing leave entitlement usage in the OrangeHRM system, including properties such as id, number of days, days used, date range, and length in days, along with standard getter and setter methods.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementUsage
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) representing the usage details of leave entitlement, including the period and amount of leave used.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the leave entitlement usage with id, total days, days used, date range, and length in days.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the leave entitlement usage record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the leave entitlement usage record.

methods.name: getNoOfDays
methods.description: Returns the total number of days entitled.

methods.name: setNoOfDays
methods.description: Sets the total number of days entitled.

methods.name: getDaysUsed
methods.description: Returns the number of days used.

methods.name: setDaysUsed
methods.description: Sets the number of days used.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Retrieves the start date of the leave period.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the leave period.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Retrieves the end date of the leave period.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the leave period.

methods.name: getLengthDays
methods.description: Returns the length of the leave period in days.

methods.name: setLengthDays
methods.description: Sets the length of the leave period in days.
